title: Ethan's Rings
description: This mod introduces and fun way to use rings to enhance your potion gameplay with each ring gives a different potion effect!
body:
By using **Ethan's Ring Mod** you will see a new layer of excitement to your Minecraft survival experience by introducing a collection of magical rings each granting a unique effect based on vanilla Minecraft potions. With 13 different rings to discover and craft, you'll gain powerful potion effects just by keeping them in your inventory. Whether you need to boost your health increase your speed or gain other beneficial effects these rings offer a convenient and fun way to enhance your gameplay.

Each ring provides a distinct effect allowing you to tailor your abilities and strategy for different situations. Crafting these rings adds a whole new dimension to your survival world making your adventure even more thrilling and dynamic. Embrace the magic of these rings and take your Minecraft experience to the next level!
